article.title: Towns stop the data centers, the Senate moves to stop the towns
article.author: Editor
article.content: Town by town, working people have been stopping the data centers the AI monopolies want to build. They have packed hearings, voted the projects down and taken the companies to court. The monopolies can’t get past them, so they have turned to Congress. The post Towns stop the data centers, the Senate moves to stop the towns appeared first on MR Online .
